name: oddo-ai-monorepo
description: Oddo AI - Full-Stack Monorepo (Next.js Frontend + Express.js Backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
